identity.author: Bedrock-OSS (JannisX11 and contributors)
identity.description: A community-maintained registry mapping Minecraft Bedrock Add-On namespaces to creator/display metadata, published as an npm package for other add-ons (e.g., WAILA-style tools) to consume.

constraints: Requires attribution: MIT requires retaining the copyright notice

scripts: Registry lookup helper (`Registry[namespace]`) consumed from @minecraft/server scripts

customCapabilities.discovery: community pull-request-curated namespace-to-creator/display-name mapping, merged into one published registry.js

manifestEvidence: README: community registry mapping Add-On namespaces to basic metadata, intended for WAILA-style consumers
scriptEvidence: Documented `import { Registry } from "@bedrock-oss/add-on-registry"` usage resolving a namespace to a display name

strongIndicators: 42 contributors and 39 forks, indicating active community namespace registration
Clear contribution workflow (per-creator JSON files merged into one registry.js) and npm distribution
weakIndicators: Registry is metadata-only (namespace to display name/creator); it carries no capability implementation of its own
gaps: Source was not opened or copied; facts are README-level only

implementationFacts.implementationPattern: Cross-addon metadata registry: creators contribute a namespace-keyed JSON file via pull request; a build step merges all entries into one published registry.js, and consuming add-ons resolve a namespace to a display name/creator at runtime
limitations: Metadata only; not a capability or behavior implementation reference
persistenceMethods: Static, build-time-merged registry consumed as a plain object lookup

reviewNotes: Reviewed 2026-09-11 against the public README, root file listing (LICENSE), and release/contributor history.
Only README-level facts were used; no registry source or third-party creator metadata was copied into Hydraulic.
